description: A stereo bus processor for the end of a Submit chain: transient shaping, bus compression, stereo width, output gain and a limiter, applied in that order

params.text: Sets the final gain, from silence to one and a half times, applied before the limiter
Sharpens attacks by up to 6dB when turned up and softens them by up to 6dB when turned down; centre leaves them alone
Bus compression: raising it lowers the threshold from -2dB to -12dB, raises the ratio from 1 to 4, blends the compressed signal in by the same amount and adds a little saturation
Sets the stereo width: nothing but the centre at zero, unchanged at one, and twice the side content at two. Widening past one leaves the side content below 140Hz nearly untouched
Brings in a limiter and lowers its ceiling from 6V to 3.75V as it is raised; at zero nothing is limited

inputs.text: The right audio input; it follows the left input when unpatched

outputs.text: The left output, after all five stages
The right output, after all five stages

notes: the input is clamped to ±20V before anything else happens, and the output is clamped to ±20V again; the red lamp lights for a quarter of a second whenever the output passes ±5V

inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left input.
